arguments.message: You are the best of best!!!!

concurrency_condition: Exclusive benchmark window; no other intentional GPU/CPU workload. Windows desktop applications remain present; GPU telemetry recorded.
method: Identical finite nonce set for every variant, search=False; same live CUDA backend and same warmed spawn pool. Independent proof checks and actual production coordinator IPC/readback/validation costs included. Sorted unique-coverage audit and overlap calculation excluded for every variant. Both devices must finish overlapping work.
limitations: One PC/input/range; no universal fastest hardware or strategy claim.
Startup, compilation, process creation, HTTP and SQLite persistence excluded.
GPU host interval includes launch/readback. The positive kernel-overlap lower bound subtracts all non-kernel host time using actual CUDA-event kernel durations.
CPU timestamps come from actual worker execution, not submission or queue time.
Fixed-work hybrid waits for its CPU tail; real proof search has separately tested cancellation/cleanup.
Only the first sample retains full batch timings; every sample audits exact unique coverage.
